scripts.check: npm run check:layers && npm run check:claude-md
scripts.test:sdk: cargo build -p orbital-server -p orbital-cli && npm test -w @harmony/orbital
scripts.pr:check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:factory && npm run test:starter && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.test:factory: cargo build -p orbital-server -p orbital-cli && npm test -w @harmony/factory-todo
scripts.test:frameworks: ORBITAL_FRAMEWORKS=1 cargo test -p orbital-server --test frameworks --test git -- --nocapture --test-threads=2 && npm run test:starter:lap
scripts.test:starter:lap: cargo build -p orbital-server && ORBITAL_FRAMEWORKS=1 node --conditions=orbital-source --test templates/test/lap.test.ts
